entries.claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC theorem identifies the exact full-tensor auxiliary Schouten variable, its first-order Lee-Wald current, Weyl-ghost transformation and minimal prequotient tracefree cut rank. It does not assign Bondi weights to pi_ab, construct the null-boundary ghost/antifield/BFV complex, renormalize the p0/p1 form, prove corner matching or gauge descent, compute P0/D_M charges, or establish causal, particle, scattering, stability, positivity, unitarity or quantum claims.

dispersion.statement: The auxiliary Legendre theorem is local and off shell.

lee_wald.statement: omega_aux^mu=delta A_1^ab delta Gamma_2^mu_ab-delta A_1^(mu b) delta Gamma_2^a_ab-(1<->2)

resonance.statement: No compact harmonic resonance carrier is identified with this boundary variable.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: The theorem is linear and off shell.

causal_retarded.statement: No retarded boundary Green complex is constructed.

taub_maps.statement: No second-order compact Taub map is evaluated.

scope.boundaries: candidate local cut variables at I+; no global corner matching
scope.carrier: full bulk symmetric tensors (h_ab,s_ab), with s_ab=alpha_B*Schouten_ab on elimination and two tracefree sphere-tensor components retained at a cut
scope.charge_sector: radiative tracefree tensor block; Coulombic aspects absent
scope.ell: local tensor statement before harmonic specialization
scope.k: radial Bondi expansion, not compact momentum
scope.m: local tensor statement before harmonic specialization
scope.omega: arbitrary local profiles; no frequency shell selected
scope.theory: linearized four-dimensional pure Weyl C^2 gravity in auxiliary-Schouten form
